title: Doors Open & Check-in
description: Arrive, check in, and grab your event map. First 100 families receive a special welcome gift!

title: Welcome Ceremony
description: Opening remarks from La Pietra Head of School and special guests. Overview of the day's activities.

title: All Experiences Open
description: All interactive stations, demonstrations, and activities are now available. Explore at your own pace!

title: Robotics Competition Demo
description: Watch our award-winning robotics team demonstrate their competition robot and challenge techniques.

title: Coding Workshop for Kids
description: Beginner-friendly coding session led by MIT App Inventor team. Create your first app! Limited to 20 participants.

title: HPD K9 Unit Demonstration
description: Meet the Honolulu Police Department's K9 officers and watch an exciting demonstration of their skills.

title: Lunch Break
description: Food vendors in full operation. Grab lunch and relax before the afternoon activities. All experiences remain open.

title: VR Gaming Tournament
description: Compete in our VR gaming challenge! Top scores win prizes. Sign up at the VR station.

title: Drone Flying Workshop
description: Learn to fly drones with expert instructors. Safety briefing followed by hands-on practice. Ages 10+

title: Laser Cutting Live Demo
description: Watch as we create custom designs in real-time. Submit your ideas for a chance to have yours made!

title: Career Panel: Tech in Hawaii
description: Industry professionals share their career journeys and advice. Q&A session follows. Great for teens and adults.

title: Flight Simulator Challenge
description: Test your piloting skills! Smoothest landing wins a prize. All ages welcome to try.

title: 360° Photo Session
description: Last call for family 360° photos! Get your digital copy via QR code to share on social media.

title: Prize Raffle Drawing
description: Grand prize raffle! Must be present to win. Prizes include tech gadgets, gift cards, and more.

title: Closing Remarks & Thank You
description: Final announcements and appreciation to all vendors, volunteers, and attendees. See you next year!

title: Event Ends
description: Thank you for attending! Safe travels home. Don't forget to take your raffle prizes and any purchases.
